title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 06
description:
Transform your bedroom into a celebration of America's favorite pastime with the Jeminise Personalized Baseball Comforter Bed Set. Crafted for baseball enthusiasts, this set combines comfort with custom style, making it a thoughtful gift for any occasion.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with names or text to create a unique bedding set, perfect for baseball players and fans.
  • Available Sizes: Choose from US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit your bed perfectly.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features environmental protection dyeing techniques to prevent fading and ensures smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting durability.
  • Premium Material: Made from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric, offering a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Microfiber Filling: Whole-piece microfiber filling with tight stitching prevents clumping or shifting, ensuring consistent comfort.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat. Microfiber dries quickly and becomes fluffier after washing.
  • Thoughtful Gift: An ideal present for men, women, moms, dads, and perfect for Valentine's, Mother's Day, Father's Day, or Christmas.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Design Baseball Vintage 2
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Multiple Size
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 400
Closure Type Zipper
Pillowcase Quantity 2
Age Range Description Toddler
